items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. The proposed plan is technically feasible and reversible in isolation, but no new production work or requeue is safe this cycle because 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 deployed improvements await measurement, operational/security evidence is incomplete, attribution is partial, and the authoritative candidate list is empty. Retain the three evidence-backed SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only. Continue existing repair-or-close, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, ownership, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence. Do not create change requests, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, monetization expansion, or external outreach. Preserve unknown ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, causal lift, and operational-security status.

Continue existing failure repair-or-close and evidence work only. Acceptance requires documented ownership, root cause, deduplication, smallest isolated repair, deterministic validation, rollback, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition before any deferred production item can become queue-eligible. Existing telemetry may be used as recorded; do not request duplicate telemetry or invent outcomes.

Maintain private launch gates and keep external outreach unsent. Continue the consolidated read-only rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. Public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credential or permission changes, configuration changes, dependency additions, and security-sensitive releases remain blocked pending required evidence, counsel review, and owner authorization.
